title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: 105. Regrets that the current Implementing Measures for the Statute for Members does not lay down transparency requirements for financial management of the GEA; regrets that, at its meeting on 17 October 2022, the Bureau adopted this decision without establishing any oversight framework;
